title: Declaration Base Information Package — dv1
description: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

issue.description: Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

issueLocation.description: Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

loadingList.description: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

currencyType.description: Code specifying a monetary unit or currency.

rate.description: Rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

items.description: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

name.description: Name of the party to which merchandise or services are sold.

identification.description: Identification of a party to which merchandise or services are sold.

type.description: Code specifying the type of address.

country.description: Code specifying the name of the country or other geographical entity as specified in ISO 3166 and UN/ECE Rec 3.

countrySubDivision.description: Code specifying the name of a country subdivision.

line.description: Specification of the postal delivery point such as street and number or post office box.

postcode.description: Identification of the postal zone or address.

items.description: Details related to the party to which merchandise or services are sold.

identification.description: Identification of a document providing additional information.

language.description: Code specifying the language used or requested.

items.description: Details related to additional documents as part of a declaration or as part of a response.

statement.description: Code specifying the form of an additional statement.

statementType.description: Code specifying the subject of the additional statement.

items.description: Details related to the special request from declarant to government to take or not to take action.

exitToEntryCharge.description: Amount indicating the total cost of freight, insurance and all other costs and expenses from the foreign exit location to the entry location.

freightCharge.description: Amount indicating the total costs incurred by the shipper in moving goods, by whatever means, from one place to another under the terms of the contract of carriage. In addition to transport costs, this may include such elements as packing, documentation, loading, unloading, and insurance (i.e., to the extent that they relate to the freight cost).

partyRelationship.description: Code specifying the effect of relationship existing between two parties such as financial relationship.

otherChargeDeduction.description: Amount added or subtracted from the total invoice price (depending on the trade terms) not previously taken into account when determining the customs value.

rate.description: Rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.

items.description: Details related to rate at which one specified currency is expressed in another specified currency.
Details related to the charges and deductions relevant to customs value (e.g. international freight, insurance, and post importation charges for construction, erection).

name.description: Name of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.

identification.description: Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are loaded onto the means of transport being used for their carriage.
identification.x-wco-code-list: UN/LOCODE + User codes OR User codes

items.description: Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignments) are loaded on to the active means of transport.
Details related to valuation applying to the shipment.

customsValue.description: Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment which are subject to the same customs procedure, and have the same tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

percentage.description: Percentage adjustment made to the valuation.

amount.description: Amount by which the monetary valuation was adjusted.

items.description: Details related to the goods item as declared to Government Agency.
